title: Documentation Request – STEVAL-ISD01KCB 22 kW High-End Servo Drive
content:
Dear ST Team,

We would like to request the design files and technical documentation for the STEVAL-ISD01KCB – 22 kW High-End Servo Drive SIL2 Reference Design for evaluation and reference purposes.

Kindly share the available design package, including schematics, PCB layout files, BOM, Gerber files, firmware/software package, hardware architecture documentation, technical specification, safety assessment documents, STO (Safe Torque Off) and SBC (Safe Brake Control) implementation details, TÜV safety documentation, and any other related technical documents.

If access to these materials requires an NDA, please let us know the process for obtaining access.

We appreciate your support and look forward to your response.

Best Regards,

Maryam

scraped_replies.html:
When these things are not published on the Product Page, it means that you need to request them direct from ST support - probably under NDA.

Raise a support case at https://ols.st.com/s/

Andrew,
Thanks for your reply.

I am writing to kindly ask for documentation under NDA. Pls let me know how to proceed! I mean, I have already created this current case to ask for the documentation under NDA. DO I need to create another case again?! Why the current one does not work then for that prupose?

Thanks,
Maryam

Again, you need to raise a support case at https://ols.st.com/s/

It’s not something that can be done on this user-to-user community.

 

PS:

You could also contact your local ST Sales Office; see: https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/contact-us.html

Thank you, Andrew. I got it now!

 

Regards,
Maryam
